title: Biological laboratory work
rule: Every workflow is filed under the kind of thing it exists to produce.

tree.title: Reagents and materials prepared

children.title: pH, ionic strength and osmolality adjustment
Mammalian and insect media with supplements and sera
Plant tissue culture media and hormone series
Matrices, scaffolds and coatings for 3D culture
Primer, probe and oligo working plates
Assay plate stamping and reagent pre-loading
Storage, freeze-thaw tracking and integrity checks
Labeled and modified reagents (fluorophore, biotin, isotope)
Sterile field and aseptic workspace setup

tree.output: a ready-to-use input for other work

tree.title: Specimens acquired, processed and banked

children.title: Human subject and clinical specimen collection
Environmental and field sampling (water, air, sediment, swabs)
Labeling, chain of custody and consent documentation
Blood and body fluid fractionation (plasma, serum, PBMC, CSF)
Solid tissue dissection, grossing and trimming
Tissue dissociation to cells or nuclei
Field concentration and filtration of dilute samples
Input normalization by concentration or volume
Inventory systems, barcoding and location tracking

tree.output: a biological specimen that is ready to use or ready to store

tree.title: Biomolecules isolated and purified

children.title: Low-input and cell-free (cfDNA, ctDNA, single-cell, ancient, eDNA)
Cleanup, size selection and gel recovery
Affinity capture (tag, Protein A, custom ligand)
Chromatographic separation (ion exchange, hydrophobic, size exclusion)
Carbohydrate, glycan and other biopolymer isolation

tree.output: a purified, naturally occurring biomolecule or particle

tree.title: Biomolecules and constructs built

children.title: De novo gene and fragment synthesis
Assembly (ligation, Gibson, Golden Gate, recombineering, gateway)
Propagation in host and construct recovery
Pooled guide, shRNA and variant libraries
Fragmentation, end repair and adapter ligation
Whole genome, exome and targeted panels
Single B cell and repertoire cloning
In vitro transcription and RNA modification

tree.output: a biomolecule that did not exist before this work

children.title: Liquid culture, growth monitoring and induction
Stem cell and advanced in vitro models
Pluripotent stem cell derivation and maintenance
Sterile seed, explant and callus culture
Virus isolation and propagation in host cells
Non-mammalian models (zebrafish, Drosophila, C. elegans, Xenopus)
Aquatic, avian and large animal systems
Health monitoring, welfare and colony QC

tree.title: Living systems engineered

children.title: Genome integration, deletion and marker curing
Line establishment, backcrossing and seed stock
Gene transfer and editing of primary cells

tree.output: a biological system whose genome or composition has been changed

tree.title: Specimens prepared for analysis

children.title: Chemical fixation and en bloc staining
NMR and solution scattering sample preparation
Derivatization and vial or plate loading

tree.output: a specimen in the exact physical form an instrument requires

tree.title: Measurements and characterization

children.title: Run QC and base-level quality assessment
Thermodynamic and stability assays (ITC, thermal shift)
Dose response and drug combination studies
Whole-slide scanning and digital pathology capture
In vivo study execution and readout

tree.output: data about a sample, system or organism
